issue.subject: bluestore_min_alloc_size is typed uint while _hdd/_ssd are size: "64K" means 64000 and mkfs fails
issue.description:
|Kind|option type mismatch; mkfs fails loudly (no silent misconfiguration)| |Severity|minor| |Config|@bluestore_min_alloc_size@ given with a unit suffix; workaround: use a plain number (65536)| |Real-world|*Real tools*: @ceph-conf@ and @ceph-osd --mkfs@| |Affected|main. Reproduced on origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a| |Related|tracker 72263 (feature request about multipliers for int/uint options) is not this bug| h3. Summary In global.yaml.in @bluestore_min_alloc_size@ is @type: uint@ (4749-4750), while its siblings @bluestore_min_alloc_size_hdd@ / @_ssd@ are @type: size@. @uint@ values are parsed by @strict_si_cast@ (decimal), so @64K@ = 64000, and mkfs rejects it (-EINVAL, BlueStore.cc:8851-8858). The same string works for the @_hdd@ / @_ssd@ variants. h3. Reproduction @repro.sh@: @ceph-conf --show-config-value@ for both options; mkfs with @--bluestore-min-alloc-size-hdd=64K@ (control) and @--bluestore-min-alloc-size=64K@. h3. Observed (origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a) 
== config parse
64000          (bluestore_min_alloc_size=64K)
65536          (bluestore_min_alloc_size_hdd=64K)
== mkfs with bluestore_min_alloc_size_hdd=64K (control)
mkfs ok
== mkfs with bluestore_min_alloc_size=64K
mkfs failed
bluestore(/root/bh/mas_generic) mkfs min_alloc_size 0xfa00 is not power of 2 aligned!
h3. Suggested fix Change @bluestore_min_alloc_size@ to @type: size@, like its siblings. h3. Reproducer files * "repro.sh":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/14-min-alloc-size-uint-units/repro.sh * Test patch for all gtests: "bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/common/patches/bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch
